name: Kanjuku Jokyoushi ~ Nikuyoku ni Nureru Wana
original_name: 姦熟女教師～肉欲に濡れる罠
source:
Takaya is a practice teacher. There is Yumiko, his ex-classroom teacher, at his school. He used to love her when he was a student. Of course, he still loves her.... Yumiko's daughter, Akane, is also a student of the same school and she is popular among male students. One day, Akane suddenly tells him, "I really love you. Do whatever you want to me...."

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081103100917/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011692]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
Takaya是一名实践老师。他的学校里有他的前班主任由美子。当他还是学生的时候，他就曾经爱过她。当然，他还是爱她的……由美子的女儿茜也是同一所学校的学生，在男生中很受欢迎。有一天，茜突然对他说：“我真的很爱你，你想对我做什么就做什么吧……”

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20081103100917/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011692]ErogeShop[/url]]
